direccion: 43 Peach Tree Lane, Seminary, MS, USA
descripcion: Hey, we are Morning Dew Pastures LLC, and we started raising Beef, Pork and Poultry because we were tired of a food system that disregards honest farming practices for the sake of profit. If that is what you are after too, then we invite you to join us in making a change! Our animals enjoy a low-stress environment with lots of sunshine and room to roam. They are raised with no antibiotics ever, and non-GMO feed. If you cannot stop by the farm store, we offer shipping from our farm to your house!

Visit Shaded Grove Farm Market and see firsthand how the food you are feeding your family is being raised. We offer an on-farm store where you can shop our grass-fed beef, lamb, pasture-raised pork, chicken and eggs as well as pecans, coffee, and more.
